agent-runway.name: Agent Runway
agent-runway.description: Business data for Canadian real estate agents: transactions, pipeline, CRM, expenses, forecasts. 17 read tools and 4 write tools that create and update pipeline opportunities.

authentication.instructions: Send the Supabase access token (JWT) from a signed-in Agent Runway session as a Bearer token. It expires after about an hour. Requires Pro access. There are no API keys, and OAuth is not available.
